description: Returns the timer's state to you: running, paused or stopped, with the project, the start time and the entry's ID. It shows nothing to the user: use it when another step needs the state. show_timer is the tool that shows the user their timer. timer_start, timer_stop, timer_pause and timer_resume report the state themselves, so they need no timer_status call first.
name: timer_status

duration.description: Duration of the running task in seconds

pause.description: The current break, while the timer is paused

task.description: The running task, with its project. Absent when no timer runs.

title: Get Timer Status
